profile.name: 实验工作台布局管理组件
profile.description: 用于表示和管理自动化移液工作台上载架、孔板、试剂槽、吸头架与孔位位置关系的非实体软件组件。它可解析工作台模板文件，维护 labware 与 DiTi 吸头系列，记录当前对象与下一个可用位置，并为实验协议提供布局、选择和位置计算信息。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for representing and managing the layout of carriers, labware, wells, tip racks, and positions on an automated liquid-handling worktable. It can parse worktable template files, maintain labware and DiTi tip series, track the current object and next usable position, and provide layout, selection, and position-calculation information for experiment protocols.
